posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Tesla VP of Hardware Engineering Lars Moravy explains to Hagerty how the Roadster borrows SpaceX cold gas thrusters to make 0 to 60 possible in 0.55 seconds.

Truly insane:

▫️ 200L carbon-over wrapped pressure vessel
behind seat holds nitrogen at 10,000 PSI
▫️cold gas thrusters push out 80 kN of thrust (equivalent to a single fighter jet engine)
▫️Tesla went with nitrogen because “it just seemed wrong to put fuel into a car” (air is ~80% nitrogen, fair enough)
▫️thrusters same system satellites use to move in space (eg. the “psh psh psh" from Apollo 13 film)
▫️currently takes 6 to 7 hours to refill all nitrogen but Tesla working for it to be 30 minutes
▫️uses leg actuators from Optimus robot to manage downforce on wing 

***

Full 25-min episode with Henry Catchpole here: https://youtu.be/22rvpUecLts?si=jtwK4t58kotdGkyi

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
SpaceXSI is putting serious effort into Grok Bot for businesses, and the potential economic impact is really enormous

SpaceXSI's internal Haggle Bot identified over $100,000 in savings in its first week by analyzing vendor contracts, unused software subscriptions and recurring purchases

Now SpaceXSI is developing a specialized Haggle Bot for businesses, with the goal of improving enterprise cost efficiency by 5% or more

At a global scale, Elon estimated this could translate into up to $6 trillion in annual savings when applied to global GDP

And SpaceXSI is making the Grok Bots its own teams use available through its marketplace, allowing other businesses to benefit from the same technology

This is where SI agents become incredibly valuable, going beyond answering questions to directly improving how businesses operate

We have worked closely with regulators, industry and operators in India for 5+ years, and built a network of dedicated systems, gateways, and other infrastructure all in-country to exclusively serve Indian traffic safely and securely - and all with the requisite government approvals.

Starlink is ready to connect India with high-speed internet.

quote.author: RIL_Updates
quote.name: Reliance Industries Limited
quote.text:
Statement from Reliance Industries 

In light of recent remarks about Reliance and the Indian market, we wish to place the facts on record.

Like every Indian enterprise, Reliance has grown in an India that welcomes investment and innovation,  homegrown or international, that improve the lives of the people.

That openness rests on the rule of law. As the Government of India has stated, it applies the same process to every applicant, Indian or foreign. Jio's own satellite services await clearances.

At Reliance,  we have never feared competition. We see it as the truest test of who serves the customer best. Jio itself entered India's crowded telecom market in 2016 as the newest player, with not a single customer. In just ten years, Jio has earned the trust of over 530 million customers and given Indians some of the best digital infrastructure and most affordable data in the world.

We welcome competition in satellite communications, including Starlink. Every player, Jio included, must serve the people of India and abide by the laws and policies of the land.
